summary.reason: The release assembly path is receipt-bound and credential-safe runtime evidence is now policy-bound, but #344 remains open because live credentialed runtime receipts are not checked in and source runtime manual-review compatibility gates still prevent the broader registry-ledger vision from being treated as complete.

criteria.goal_acceptance: Downstream impact and consumer compatibility are connected to release evidence strongly enough to answer whether a release is safe to consume, blocked, or needs manual review.

Credential-gated runtime checks now have a secret-safe policy path, but live credentialed receipts are still not checked in and default CI remains secret-free.
